app.title: MilestonePath
app.subtitle: Child Developmental & Speech-Language Tracker
app.tagline: Evidence-based developmental surveillance for clinicians & parents
app.disclaimer_short: For tracking & educational use only. Not a diagnostic tool.
app.disclaimer_long: This application provides educational and developmental surveillance guidance based on CDC, ASHA, Northern & Downs, AIISH, JCIH, and Crowe & McLeod norms. It does not replace formal clinical assessment or diagnostic testing by certified speech-language pathologists, pediatric audiologists, or developmental pediatricians.

roles.professional_desc: For SLPs, Pediatricians, Early Interventionists & Special Educators
roles.parent_desc: For parents and families to track, celebrate, and support daily milestones

hrr.title: High Risk Register for Hearing & Communication Disorders
hrr.subtitle: Joint Committee on Infant Hearing (JCIH) & Indian RBSK / AIISH Clinical Risk Surveillance
hrr.high_risk: High Risk – Prompt Audiology & SLP Referral Indicated
hrr.no_positive_factors: No positive risk indicators reported in this assessment.
hrr.disclaimer: Triage screening tool only. Positive indicators warrant formal audiological diagnostic testing (BERA/DPOAE) and speech-language assessment.

parent.what_to_look: What to Look For at Home
parent.try_at_home: Try This at Home (Parent Play Tip)
parent.gentle_note: Every child develops at their own pace. If a skill isn't seen yet, continue playful stimulation and mention it to your pediatrician at your next well-child visit.
parent.bilingual_reassurance: Indian Household Tip: Raising your child with multiple languages (e.g. Kannada, Hindi, and English) is wonderful and does NOT delay speech development!
